sahneler.metin: A small submersible diving to the Titanic imploded.
It was destroyed instantly, and all five aboard were killed.
Its hull was made of carbon fibre.
Carbon fibre is superb in tension but less predictable under deep-sea pressure.
Every dive stressed the hull again.
Damage built up inside the layers.
The sub had never been independently certified.
It renewed calls for certifying every deep submersible.

aciklama:
Titan imploded on a dive to the Titanic. The cause: cumulative damage and delamination in a carbon fibre composite pressure hull.
